Digital Operations Manager (Mid, DACH region) Aarhus or Hamburg | Full-time | Hybrid (3+ days a week in the office)

About AutoUncle

Buying a used car is one of the biggest purchases most people make, and one of the hardest to get right. Is the price fair? What will it really cost? AutoUncle was founded to answer those questions. Today, car buyers across Europe use our websites and apps to compare almost every used car for sale and see whether the price is right, for free.

The car dealerships that sell to those buyers are our customers. Over 700 of them use AutoUncle to sell more cars. We send them buyers who are ready to act, and we put tools on their websites that turn visitors into leads.

Now we're going a step further. CoDriver, our newest product, is an AI assistant that answers every lead a dealer gets, on every channel, day or night, and keeps the conversation going until the buyer is ready. We're no longer just sending buyers to dealers; we're helping them close the sale.

Why we’re hiring

AutoUncle is growing fast. More dealers are signing up, and more of them are choosing CoDriver, which connects directly to their CRM, lead providers and website. Every new customer means a new setup to get right and keep running.

The Digital Operations Team

That's where our Digital Operations Team comes in. Sales wins the customer; Digital Operations makes our products work for them. The team gets new dealers live, keeps their integrations healthy and fixes issues quickly when something breaks. A dealer only sees value once leads are flowing, so this team has a direct hand in whether customers stay and grow with us.

The team works across Denmark, Germany and Italy, and we're looking to add someone in the near future to our DACH team to support our growth in the region.

Your mission

Own the technical setup for a portfolio of 60–80 DACH customers, from first call to go-live and beyond. Make sure every product we deliver is properly integrated, measurable from day one, and keeps working.

Day to day, you’ll:

• 
Lead technical onboardings. Connect our products with dealer websites, CRM systems and inventory feeds, and coordinate more complex or tailored integrations.

• 
Join customer meetings alongside Sales, answer technical questions in German and set clear expectations on feasibility and go-live timelines.

• 
Pick up the phone to unblock setups. Reach out to web agencies, CRM providers and dealer IT contacts to solve problems quickly.

• 
Diagnose tracking and data issues. Investigate GA4, Google Tag Manager, consent mode and event tracking when numbers don’t add up, and find out why, not just what.

• 
Customize and improve. Adjust widgets with custom CSS and improve our standard integrations to give customers’ website visitors a better experience.

• 
Keep your portfolio healthy with regular health checks, inventory quality checks and proactive monitoring.

• 
Build repeatable systems. Turn recurring problems into standard workflows, documentation, and AI workflows and automations the whole team uses, and work with product and tech colleagues to drive improvements.

What you bring

• 
Native or near-native German, and fluent English (our company language)

• 
2+ years of experience in technical integrations, implementation, digital operations or a similar role, ideally in B2B SaaS

• 
Hands-on experience with web analytics and tracking (GA4, Google Tag Manager or similar). You understand events, conversions and consent mode well enough to troubleshoot them

• 
A basic understanding of APIs and how systems exchange data

• 
HTML/CSS skills for adjusting and troubleshooting website integrations

• 
Confidence picking up the phone and working with both technical (developers, CRM providers) and non-technical (dealers, sales teams) contacts

• 
A structured way of working: you run several setups at once, prioritize your own pipeline and follow through without being chased

• 
You already use AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT or similar) to get real work done, and you can tell us about something you automated or made faster.

Nice to have:

• 
Experience in the automotive industry or at a web agency

• 
Experience with HubSpot or dealer CRM systems

What we offer

• 
€54,600–67,800 gross annual (final salary depending on experience)

• 
Extended social benefits; including 30 holiday days + local holidays, extended parental leave, etc. See more in our Employee Handbook!

• 
Structured training in your first three months, alongside experienced teammates, on our products (Traffic Performance, Website Booster and CoDriver),and how dealerships work

• 
A clear path to Senior Digital Operations Manager, by owning a specialist area such as data quality, website tracking or partner integrations

• 
A growth review every six months and support from your manager to plan your next step

• 
Impact you can see: when a dealer goes live and the leads start coming in, you made that happen

How we work

We're AI-native, and you'll help shape how we use AI in customer operations.

AutoUncle moves fast, and priorities can change from week to week. If you haven't worked somewhere like this before, that's fine. If the idea sounds exciting rather than stressful, you'll fit right in.

We hire for four traits we call "the Ticket": being ambitious, humble and coachable, with a bias for action. We also live by the Five Cs: Clear, Courage, Curiosity, Commitment and Compassion. Our Employee Handbook gives a good feel for how we work.

The process

• 
Intro call with our Talent Acquisition team

• 
Interview with the hiring managers, conducted in English. Then a short conversation in German with a team member

• 
A short personality test (online, in your own time), followed by a case interview where you’ll also meet the team

• 
Reference checks

The AutoUncle Pitch Most people know AutoUncle for the consumer service (native apps and web) used by millions of consumers in 14 European countries. But, new colleagues tend to get very excited when they see the technological depth there is to AutoUncle’s platform (car valuations based on advanced statistics, indexing and data processing of millions of cars daily, pro dealership tools, automatic marketing platforms, automated billing and so much more). The company is financially strong and operates like a fast growing scale-up. There is a clear company vision (driven forward with OKRs) and a healthy work culture. A once-in-a-company opportunity to lead engineering early as the company scales! 🚀

At proprty.ai, we’re building domain-specific AI for data-driven building maintenance and portfolio planning. Our predictive models estimate the condition and remaining lifespan of building components, and we turn that into prioritised maintenance plans across entire portfolios. Our AI agent, Tily, can take action on users' behalf and help them run strategic analysis of their building portfolio, helping large property owners and managers maintain their buildings efficiently, cost-effectively and sustainably.

The product went live in 2024 and is already solving real problems for real people, with customers across Denmark, Norway, and Germany. There is still so much we can do to make it even better, and you could help shape the future of building maintenance – and how engineering is run at proprty.ai.

What we're looking for

We're looking for a player-coach who loves leading engineers and still wants to write code. You might coach a developer through a tricky problem in the morning and ship a feature yourself in the afternoon.

You've led an engineering team before at a startup or scale-up where the foundations were still being laid, and you know that in a small team, leadership means leading by doing. You care about shipping fast and shipping well.

We're an AI-first company (it's in our name). You've built AI agents and AI features into real products, and you're excited to push that further, both in what we build for customers and in how the team works.

About the team

We're a small but mighty crew of four engineers who love solving tricky problems together, working on-site in our office near Rådhuspladsen. We work closely with our data science team to bring machine learning models trained on millions of m² of building data into the product. We talk a lot (in a good way), pair up when things get tough, and keep the vibe light with plenty of jokes and good energy.

About the role

• 
Lead, coach, and grow the team as a player-coach, while still writing code on core features

• 
Own how we build and ship. Our goal is to release several times a week without letting quality, reliability, or security slip

• 
Guide the platform's technical direction, including architecture and code quality

• 
Design and build AI agents and AI features into the product, and work with Data Science to take models from prototype to production

• 
Help turn input from customers, Sales and Customer Success into features the team can build

• 
Improve the team's AI tools and workflows (we use Cursor and Perplexity) so everyone can build faste

About you

• 
You've led an engineering team before at a startup or scale-up, including coaching and hiring developers

• 
You have strong hands-on full-stack experience with React, TypeScript and SQL

• 
You've built (or have strong interest in) AI agents and AI features in production

• 
You take full ownership from design to implementation, and you lead by doing

• 
You live in the Copenhagen area (we're in the office 4 days a week)

• 
Bonus points if you've worked with Postgres and Next.js, or in real estate or proptech

Even if you don't tick every box, we'd still love to hear from you if you're an experienced engineering leader who learns fast and loves building things!

TL;DR

Want to get in early with a great team? Love leading engineers and still writing code? Apply now to lead our dev team and make building maintenance smarter and more sustainable with AI.

For more information or questions please contact us at ss@proprty.ai

Working at

proprty.ai

proprty.ai is building a service to help Danish property managers leverage machine learning technology to create better condition assessments and maintenance plans. The cost of maintaining the Danish property mass is growing fast, and property managers are struggling to keep up with maintenance and regulatory responsibilities. This is not only hurting the property managers, but also the people using and living in the buildings. The challenge to live up to the EU Taxonomy for Sustainable Activities, is made harder, by not having the tools nor data to make the right strategic choices when planning and executing maintenance. With our service we aim to create property condition assessment and maintenance plans faster and more accurately than what is possible today. Using machine learning algorithms trained on millions of m2 worth of data, we can provide property managers with data to make the right decisions, when it comes to spending resources on maintenance. That way they can cut costs, improve property conditions and push the property mass towards a sustainable future. We're creating an AI powered web platform, that allows property managers to create condition assessments and maintenance plans in a fraction of the time they're using today, by mixing output from our machine learning models with boots on the ground input. It's not only faster. It provides high quality data instead of subjective information. At proprty.ai we've already signed partnerships with 18% of the Danish residential property market. We have a very real problem to solve, and a strong team to do it.

Would you like to become the technical go-to person for the systems that keep a fleet of working vessels accurate and operational? At HØJ Nordic Marine Contractor, you will take ownership of dredging systems, survey equipment and onboard IT across the fleet, with plenty of freedom to shape how the area is run.

Take technical ownership across the fleet

HØJ Nordic Marine Contractor has delivered marine construction projects since 1958 and today works across Northern Europe within dredging, offshore wind, coastal protection and maritime infrastructure.

As the fleet grows, HØJ wants to bring more technical knowledge in-house. You will join the technical team in Horsens, where you will take specialist responsibility for the systems connecting dredging operations, positioning, survey equipment and onboard IT. While your colleagues cover other technical areas across the fleet, your primary focus will be the dredging systems and the related IT and survey technology.

Your main focus will be the 3D dredging systems across seven vessels, including Teledyne PDS, positioning equipment, sensors and the supporting IT setup. You will work closely with skippers, crews, project managers and suppliers and become the person they turn to when systems need to be set up, improved or brought back online.

Some days, you will work alongside your colleagues in the technical team in Horsens, planning and coordinating maintenance, configuring systems or supporting vessels remotely. Other days, you will be on board troubleshooting equipment, preparing a vessel for a new project or carrying out planned service and maintenance.

The aim is not only to solve problems when they occur, but to create a more consistent, well-documented and reliable setup across the fleet.

More specifically, you will:

• Take technical ownership of the fleet’s dredging systems and Teledyne PDS setup

• Work with positioning, sensors, multibeam and other survey equipment

• Support and improve onboard IT, networks and communication systems

• Plan preventive maintenance, calibrations and service

• Document the technical setup on each vessel and prepare relevant reports

• Support crews and project managers with troubleshooting and project preparation

One of your first tasks will be to map the existing system landscape across the vessels. You will also help commission the dredging system on a new vessel and establish clearer standards across the fleet.

Mechanical Engineer – FLOWVISION A/S

About FLOWVISION A/S

FLOWVISION A/S is a Danish engineering company founded in 2006, specialized in designing and delivering advanced emission abatement systems for combustion-based power plants worldwide. Since 2021, the company has been part of AXENS GROUP, while continuing to operate as an independent business with its own organization, commercial responsibility, and market-facing role.

The company operates in an international EPC environment and delivers technically advanced solutions to customers within the energy, oil & gas, and industrial sectors across multiple global markets. FLOWVISION collaborates closely with major international players and is recognized for its strong technical know-how, high-quality standards, and ability to solve complex engineering challenges.

Today, FLOWVISION employs around 20 highly skilled specialists, creating a strong concentration of technical competencies and deep industry expertise. This gives the company the agility and close collaboration of a small expert team, combined with the backing and broader industrial context of being part of Axens.

FLOWVISION offers a flat organizational structure, short decision-making processes, and a collaborative culture where openness, knowledge sharing, and teamwork are essential parts of everyday life.

The company is currently experiencing significant growth and a strong order intake, creating attractive opportunities for professionals who want to influence both project execution and the continued development of the business.

The position

As Mechanical Engineer, you will become part of FLOWVISION’s highly specialized engineering environment and play a key role in the execution of technically advanced international EPC projects.

You will work closely with our Lead Mechanical Engineer, Project Managers, workshops, suppliers, and external engineering partners to ensure that mechanical designs, fabrication documentation, and technical solutions are delivered with high quality and according to demanding project timelines.

The role combines hands-on engineering with close interaction across fabrication, welding, procurement, and project execution activities. You will contribute throughout the entire project lifecycle — from bid clarification and design reviews to fabrication support, inspections, and final documentation.

This is a role for someone who enjoys solving practical engineering challenges, working close to production realities, and operating in an environment where technical quality, collaboration, and execution are critical to success.

You will also have the opportunity to influence engineering processes and contribute to the continued professionalization and growth of the business.

Key responsibilities

Mechanical project execution

• Participate in technical reviews of RFQ packages and specifications during bidding and project execution phases.

• Support clarification processes and ensure alignment of technical scope, assumptions, and interfaces.

• Define mechanical design requirements and coordinate engineering inputs towards external engineering and drafting partners.

• Work with mechanical drawings and technical documentation, including general arrangements, structural steel drawings, piping layouts, isometrics, and fabrication documentation.

• Support structured engineering milestone reviews and contribute to design acceptance and design freeze activities.

• Identify and resolve technical issues, deviations, and design changes throughout the project lifecycle.

• Assess manufacturability and propose practical engineering improvements related to fabrication, welding, installation, and assembly.

Fabrication, welding & workshop interface

• Act as a daily technical interface towards workshops and fabrication partners.

• Handle technical clarifications during fabrication and pre-assembly activities.

• Participate in workshop activities such as PIM, pre-FAT, FAT, inspections, and technical follow-up.

• Support resolution of punch items, deviations, and non-conformities together with Project Management and QHSE.

Documentation & engineering coordination

• Prepare and consolidate mechanical engineering documentation for customer deliveries.

• Work actively with engineering data, revisions, BOM structures, and document control processes.

• Support procurement activities through technical review of supplier quotations and deviations.

• Contribute to maintaining technical quality, traceability, and compliance across all project phases.

Qualifications

We expect you to have:

• A technical degree within Mechanical Engineering or a similar engineering discipline.

• Experience from project-based engineering environments, fabrication, workshops, or EPC project execution.

• Practical exposure to welding, piping, valves, structural steel, or process equipment.

• Strong ability to read, review, and assess mechanical and fabrication drawings.

• Familiarity with relevant standards such as ASME and EN1090.

• Experience working with AutoCAD or similar 2D/3D CAD systems. Plant3D is preferred.

• Experience working with drawings, revisions, BOM structures, and document management systems.

• A structured, analytical, and proactive mindset with strong attention to detail.

• The ability to collaborate effectively across engineering, quality, procurement, and project functions.

• Strong English communication skills, written and spoken. Danish is considered an advantage.

Practical information

• Location: FLOWVISION A/S, Odense, Denmark

• Reporting line: COO / Lead Mechanical Engineer

• Travel activity: Approx. 20–30 days annually depending on projects

What we offer

FLOWVISION offers a unique opportunity to become part of a highly specialized and growing international engineering company where technical know-how and collaboration are the core drivers of success.

We offer:

• A key technical role in an international and rapidly growing engineering company.

• The opportunity to work on technically advanced and highly challenging international EPC projects.

• A unique environment with a strong concentration of specialist competencies and technical expertise.

• Excellent opportunities for professional and personal development as the company continues its growth and professionalization journey.

• A high degree of influence on engineering solutions, project execution, and ways of working.

• A flat organization with fast decision-making and close collaboration across the company.

• A versatile and dynamic workday characterized by openness, cooperation, flexibility, and humor.

• A strong development culture with high ambitions regarding quality, innovation, and employee well-being.

• Office location in Odense with international exposure and limited travel activity.

FLOWVISION is a company where highly skilled people work closely together to deliver complex solutions to global customers — and where the right person will have the opportunity to make a visible impact on both projects and the future development of the business.

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer with expertise in kinematics and control systems to join our On-Machine Software team in Odense, Denmark, or Stockholm, Sweden. In this role, you will develop the software that enable construction machines to operate with greater precision, automation, and autonomy.

You will be part of the On-Machine Software department, where we design and develop developing technology used every day on construction sites around the world. Our software allows construction machines to understand their surroundings and execute precise movements.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will contribute across the full software development lifecycle, from concept and architecture discussions to implementation, testing, and operational support. You will collaborate with software, hardware, and product teams to deliver robust, high-quality solutions.

A particular focus of this role will be supporting and evolving key machine control applications while contributing expertise in system design, software architecture, kinematics, control systems, sensor integration, and advanced software development practices.

• Contribute to technical decisions, architecture, and system design.

• Take ownership of key software components and drive improvements.

You thrive on tackling complex system-level challenges and are often the person colleagues turn to for technical guidance. While you work well independently when needed, you also enjoy collaborating with others and sharing your expertise in our global organization.

• Strong C++ development skills.

Are you passionate about building and running reliable, scalable and secure cloud data platforms? Do you want to work in the offshore wind industry, where your engineering skills will help secure a sustainable future based on renewable energy? Then keep reading: Cadeler is looking for a Data Platform Engineer with your skills and interests!

Cadeler is a global partner in the offshore wind industry, specializing in wind farm construction and maintenance. Our industry is more relevant than ever and plays a critical role in the energy transition, with a strong long-term outlook. As our industry continues to develop, so do we!

We are now looking for a Data Platform Engineer to help build, automate and operate our cloud data platform, ensuring that trusted and well-governed data is available for analytics, reporting and operational decision-making.

**What will you do?

**As our Data Platform Engineer, you will design, build and operate the technical foundations of Cadeler's data platform on Snowflake and Azure. You will work with business teams, application owners, IT and information security to integrate source systems, automate data pipelines and make reliable data available for analytics and reporting.

**Your Main Tasks Include

**

• Design, build and maintain data pipelines from various source systems, using managed ingestion tools such as Fivetran and custom Python where connectors fall short

• Orchestrate and schedule pipelines, handle dependencies, retries and backfills, and manage Snowflake warehouse sizing and compute cost

• Own CI/CD and source control in Azure DevOps: branching strategy, PR reviews, automated deployments and environment promotion (dev, test, prod), with database objects and infrastructure managed as code

• Design and implement dimensional data models (facts, dimensions, star schemas, slowly changing dimensions) across raw, staging, integration and mart layers

• Set up pipeline monitoring, anomaly detection and alerting, and troubleshoot and resolve incidents in production

• Deliver curated, performant datasets and semantic-ready measures so departments can build reports in Power BI

**To Succeed In This Role

**Being part of the Cadeler community means having a natural interest in and care for the environment, and in our shared mission to speed up the green energy transition. Environmental considerations and the safety of our people and the planet will be a key priority in your daily work.

We are looking for an innovator with a solution-oriented mind, who thrives in a fast-paced environment with many different interfaces.

We think you will be a good match if you have:

• A university degree in a relevant area such as computing, statistics or mathematics

• 3+ years of hands-on experience as a data engineer or data platform engineer

• Proven experience designing, building and operating production data pipelines

• Advanced SQL skills and strong Python skills for data processing, automation and tooling, and experience with dimensional modelling

• Hands-on experience with Snowflake (warehouses, RBAC, storage and compute management, cost control) and the Azure ecosystem

• An understanding of data security, governance and access control principles, as well as ability to define and write logic that transforms raw data into useful, interpretable, business-driven datasets

• Fluent spoken and written English
